comment: Failing cases (Fail, Crash, Timeout, ...) in committed baselines that WineMetalGL does not change behaviour for, with the reason. scripts/docs/generate.py prints the reason next to the case and fails if an entry matches no failing result. A case without an entry is listed as not yet explained.

entries.reason: In configurations 3 and 4 (`--deqp-surface-type=fbo`) the test saves `GL_READ_BUFFER` while the CTS framebuffer object is bound (`GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0`), deletes its own bound framebuffer object, which rebinds framebuffer zero, and restores the saved value there (glcApiCoverageTests.cpp, TestCoverageGLCallReadBuffer). The default framebuffer has no `GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0` buffer, and `glReadBuffer` generates `GL_INVALID_OPERATION` for a buffer that does not exist, as the specification requires.

The case compiles compute shaders on every desktop GL version without checking for GL 4.3 or `GL_ARB_compute_shader` (glcShaderNegativeTests.cpp, ShaderNonPrecisionQualifiersStructCase). WineMetalGL does not expose compute shaders below GL 4.3, so `glCreateShader(GL_COMPUTE_SHADER)` generates `GL_INVALID_ENUM`, as the specification requires for an unsupported shader type.

The case checks only for `GL_ARB_buffer_storage` (gl4cMapBufferAlignmentTests.cpp, Functional::init) and then binds and sizes buffers for `GL_DISPATCH_INDIRECT_BUFFER`, `GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER` (GL 4.3) and `GL_QUERY_BUFFER` (GL 4.4) and queries `GL_MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK_SIZE`. `GL_ARB_buffer_storage` does not add those targets, so a GL 4.2 context generates `GL_INVALID_ENUM` for them, as the specification requires.

The case calls `glGetProgramInterfaceiv` (GL 4.3, `GL_ARB_program_interface_query`) without checking for it (gl4cShaderSubroutineTests.cpp, APITest2::verifyGLGetActiveSubroutineNameFunctionality). The CTS loads that entry point only for GL 4.3 contexts or when the extension is advertised, so in a GL 4.2 context it calls a null function pointer and the process crashes.

The case calls `glGetTransformFeedbacki64_v` (GL 4.5, `GL_ARB_direct_state_access`) without checking for it (glcTransformFeedbackTests.cpp). The CTS loads that entry point only for GL 4.5 contexts or when the extension is advertised, so in a GL 4.2 context it calls a null function pointer and the process crashes. WineMetalGL implements the query (the KHR-GL45 copy of the case passes under the development override).

The case expects `glRenderbufferStorage(GL_RGB9_E5)` to succeed (glcInternalformatTests.cpp, RenderbufferCase::createAndAttachRenderBuffer). GL 4.2 section 4.4.2.1 requires `GL_INVALID_ENUM` for an internal format that is not color-, depth- or stencil-renderable, and table 3.12 does not list `GL_RGB9_E5` as color-renderable.
